source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1952: nominations 20 May 1952; every seat returned unopposed. The list prints no party labels (so none are given) and has no entry for Crossmore. Returned unopposed. William J. Black: no party label printed in 1952. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Killeen, Armagh Rural District, 3 October 1946, printed 'U': Frontier Sentinel, 28 September 1946, p. 5 ("Armagh Rural Council"); Richhill, 5 June 1958, printed 'U.': Armagh Guardian, 23 May 1958, p. 4 ("Local Council Elections: No Contests for County Council")).
